"Oh, so you guys came too?{w}Me? Oh, this and that. Work, you know."{w}

"By the way, have you got your gear sorted out properly?{w}Items don't do a thing unless you equip them."{w}{p}"If you've got a mage with you, I'd say you need to equip the Magic Seals, or they won't have any effect."{w}
"Recommended spots?{w}Well, there's Abi, west of the forest, I guess."{w}{p}"Who's Abi, you ask?{w}Well, you'll see when you meet Abi. Yep."{w}

"Watch out for Floor Masters.{w}The ones out for blood are usually red. If you spot a red shadow, be careful."{w}{p}"As long as you don't attack a Floor Master first or get in its way, it won't come to a fight."{w}{p}"But if you mean to block its path, you'll earn the wrath of the floor's boss, so you'd better be prepared for what comes."{w}{p}"Some of them are a real pain and'll chase you, but the rest are all gentle types who walk a set route."{w}{p}"Oh, and even if it does come to a fight, don't give up, okay?{w}If you're lucky, you can get away."{w}

"Hmm, nothing in particular, but..."{w}{p}"Ever heard of the Innocent series?{w}There's a sword, a shield and a cloak."{w}{p}"They're pretty powerful, but only someone who's never changed class can equip them."{w}

"You guys...{w}Are you actually making progress on the Proclamation?"{w}{p}"I dunno, man.{w}From the outside, it doesn't look like it's going too well."{w}{p}"If you're stuck, it's farming. Nothing else for it.{w}Why not get Chirocco to share some saplings and try growing them in Perpeco?"{w}{p}"Maybe some way to break the deadlock will come to you, huh?"{w}

"Hey, long time no see!"{w}{p}"I hear you've been doing great things. Something about taking back the Palace of the Sun?{w}Knowing I helped out a little makes me proud.{w}Keep the business coming my way!"{w}{p}"Oh, that reminds me. I had kind of a strange experience.{w}Just as I reached the Leanmakana Mountains, I got caught in this massive storm."{w}{p}"I mean, look at me. I'm pretty slim, right?{w}I got blown clean away."{w}{p}"Even I figured I was dead for sure, but then, believe it or not..."{w}{p}"I was in a castle floating in the sky."{w}{p}"And there I met a woman wearing a hood."{w}{p}"I didn't ask her name, but she told me all kinds of interesting stories."{w}{p}"Why don't you go and meet her too, if you get the chance?"{w}{p}"You might get something useful out of it."{w}{p}"Well, I'll be going now. See you."{w}
When you stepped out into the square, you saw Hanoi deep in thought.{w}{p}Hanoi noticed you as well, shouldered a backpack and came over.{w}

"Looks like you're still alive.
Good to see you're so hard to kill. Yep, yep.{w}Anyway..."{w}

"Ever heard the rumors about the Mine Trapper?{w}A weird thing with a squid for a head."{w}{p}"It looks ridiculous, but apparently it's not to be underestimated. People in the know are pretty scared of it."{w}{p}"I hadn't heard anything about it for a while, but just lately the sightings have started piling up."{w}{p}"...Ah! Don't get the wrong idea, okay?
I'm not asking you to go hunt it down.{w}I'm not expecting that much from you, so relax."{w}{p}"I'm just saying we should both be careful out there.{w}Well then..."{w}
Back in town, you were stopped by a familiar voice.{w}

"Yo. Adventuring going well?{w}I've got a soft spot for you guys, so don't go dying in a ditch on me, okay?"{w}{p}"...Though honestly, I'd rather you had a soft spot for me.{w}Ah well, I won't expect much from you lot."{w}{p}"By the way, I'm holding a package for you.{w}Hold out your hands."{w}
"Hey, that looks like pretty good stuff.{w}With this, maybe you'll turn into adventurers who actually earn a bit. I'd appreciate that... business-wise."{w}

"...Huh? You can't carry it?"{w}{p}"You're still pretty green, huh?{w}You never know what shape treasure'll come in. Always keep some room in your pack."{w}{p}"Can't be helped. I'll sell it to Gia's place, so buy it back if you want it."{w}{p}"Don't go selling other people's stuff without asking, you say?{w}Ha ha, don't worry about it. It's no big deal. Yep."{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

it means to destroy you.{w}

'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
